raw: {"diagnosis": "LBBB", "stemi": "no", "rationale": "The ST elevation in V1–V3 sits opposite deep QS/rS complexes, alongside a monophasic R in I/aVL, notched R in V5–V6 and left axis deviation; this is the expected repolarization pattern of LBBB, and from visual inspection it does not meet modified Sgarbossa criteria (no concordant STE, ST/S ratio about 0.25 or less), so the claim of acute STEMI is not supported, though bedside confirmation is still needed."}

parsed.rationale: The ST elevation in V1–V3 sits opposite deep QS/rS complexes, alongside a monophasic R in I/aVL, notched R in V5–V6 and left axis deviation; this is the expected repolarization pattern of LBBB, and from visual inspection it does not meet modified Sgarbossa criteria (no concordant STE, ST/S ratio about 0.25 or less), so the claim of acute STEMI is not supported, though bedside confirmation is still needed.
